simple.meaning: חָרָבָה (chârâbâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a desert.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 7:22. The surrounding context includes death, covenant, priesthood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָרָבָה (H2724) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חָרָבָה (chârâbâh) / H2724 is traced through Genesis 7:22, Exodus 14:21, Joshua 3:17, Joshua 4:18 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.
Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters, and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.
I will make the rivers dry,
For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

definitions.full: H2724. charabah חָֽרָבָה noun feminine dry ground ; — absolute ׳ח Gen 7:22 7 t.; opposed to הַיָּם Exod 14:21 (J), Hag 2:6 ; compare Gen 7:22 (J); opposed to water of Jordan Josh 3:17 (twice in verse) (J), 4:18 (E), 2Kin 2:8 ; of Nile-arms ח יְאֹרִים ׳וְנָתַתִּ֫י Ezek 30:12 .
